verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's Default Runbook attaches to every incident and always includes an "Assign a Role" step that makes the declarer Commander, plus an "Add Task List" step. Runbooks trigger on incident declaration and can be tailored per situation or team, so roles and checklists are built into response. Missing for 10: evidence of roles beyond Commander (e.g. a comms lead or custom role definitions), detail on how task checklists are tracked during an incident, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
